description: Regular (non-flyer) prices for staples, for items not on sale this week. Store shelf prices are No Frills only for now. One row per product; `proxy: true` means the price was read at another branch of the banner. Each row carries `baseline`, the Statistics Canada Ontario average for that kind of item when there is one, and `vsOntarioAveragePct`. When no store price exists (e.g. Food Basics, FreshCo), `hits` is empty and `fallback` holds only the StatCan averages: say they are provincial averages, not what a store charges.

fields.description: Return only these fields per row (offerId and priceKind are always kept), to save tokens.

near.description: Where the shopper is: a Canadian postal code ("M6H 2B6"), an FSA ("M6H"), or "lat,lng".

name: shelf_prices
title: Everyday shelf prices
